m_216352ab01f7.en: Place stones on intersections. Surround an opponent group to capture it. Suicide and prohibited repetition are blocked. Pass when there are no useful moves; both players then review dead stones, seki and the score.
m_216352ab01f7.zh-Hant: 在交點落子，包圍對方棋塊即可提子。系統會阻止自殺與規則禁止的重複局面。無需繼續落子時可停著，雙方再確認死棋、雙活與計分。

m_6eb2da6904c3.en: Chinese uses area scoring and positional superko with a published no-result procedure for exceptional cycles. Japanese 1989 uses territory, prisoners, simple ko and mutual final agreement. Special life-and-death confirmation can require adjudication: an unresolved position is never automatically awarded. AGA uses situational superko, pass stones, White last, area scoring and handicap compensation.
m_6eb2da6904c3.zh-Hant: 中國規則採數子、全局同形限制，罕見循環依已公布的無勝負補充程序處理。日本 1989 規則採數目、提子、單劫與雙方終局確認；特殊死活可能需要裁定，未決局面不會自動判勝。AGA 採情境超級劫、停著交子、白方末手、數子及讓子補償。

m_a4e5bbed2ef3.en: Japanese rule examples are still being validated; do not use this app as a tournament referee. Resume play to settle a dispute where the chosen rules permit it.
m_a4e5bbed2ef3.zh-Hant: 日本規則的特殊例題仍在驗證中，本程式不能代替賽事裁判。規則允許時可透過續弈解決爭議。

m_c69e961be3d0.en: Chinese standard komi: 7.5 points = 3¾ stones. Japanese: 6.5 points. AGA: 7.5-point tournament preset. Handicap / custom komi games are not ranked.
m_c69e961be3d0.zh-Hant: 標準貼目：中國規則 7.5 點＝3¾ 子，日本規則 6.5 目，AGA 採 7.5 點比賽預設。讓子與自訂貼目不計公開戰績。

m_f69461930831.en: Online clocks keep running in the background. A continuous 120-second disconnection forfeits unless the clock expires first. Both disconnected: interrupted, with no winner. Closing an online match deliberately counts as resignation.
m_f69461930831.zh-Hant: 線上用時在背景持續計算。連續斷線 120 秒判負，若時鐘先耗盡則先判超時。雙方都斷線則中斷，不產生勝者；主動退出進行中的線上對局視為認輸。

m_1974999d9e74.en: . Go rule adaptation, AI and match flow are Workshop code.

m_eaa96a63eeda.en: Shared whiteboards are separate invitation-only copies, saved with Supabase for up to four signed-in members. Members see the drawing, public profile names, avatars, online presence and live cursors. Shared content is sent to Supabase, unlike local file tools. Only the owner manages invitations and membership. Removing a member changes channel access and invalidates the old invitation. Shared boards remain saved after everyone disconnects; the owner can delete them. Unsaved recovery copies stay on this device, isolated by account. Whiteboard, Pong and Go share a two-active-room limit.
m_eaa96a63eeda.zh-Hant: 共享白板是獨立的邀請制副本，由 Supabase 保存，最多四名登入成員可使用。成員可查看畫面、公開名稱、頭像、上線狀態與游標。共享內容會傳送至 Supabase；本機檔案工具則留在裝置。僅房主可管理邀請與成員；移除成員會更新頻道權限並使舊邀請失效。所有人離線後白板仍會保存，房主可刪除。未同步的恢復副本依帳號隔離，留在此裝置。Whiteboard、Pong 與 Go 合計最多兩個活躍房間。

m_defeb0e6e6cc.en: Go online matches store the rules, moves, clocks, membership and verified outcome on Supabase. Only match members can read the live position and private move record. Realtime carries version notifications; the server checks each move and settles the result. Standard online human matches publish completed games, wins, losses, draws and win rate under your public Profile. Practice, computer games and single-color training do not enter these statistics. Matchmaking stores a short-lived queue entry. A second tab is read-only until you explicitly take control. Online clocks continue in the background; both-player interruptions never create a winner.
m_defeb0e6e6cc.zh-Hant: 線上圍棋會在 Supabase 保存規則、著手、時鐘、成員與已驗證結果。只有對局成員可讀取即時局面及私人棋譜。Realtime 只通知版本變更，每手棋及結算皆由伺服器驗證。標準線上真人局會在公開 Profile 顯示完局、勝、負、和與勝率；練習、人機與單色訓練不計入。配對佇列僅短期保存。額外分頁在明確接管前為唯讀。背景持續計時，雙方中斷不會產生勝者。
